title: GSE-Graph axis-anchored multi-label event-relation three-seed training
purpose: Determine whether five causal LiDAR scans can learn five structural events, independent persistent/reveal/withdraw relations, current branch geometry, continuous tunnel geometry and safe place/branch association strongly enough to justify relation-aware topology experiments.

approval.scope: One immutable three-seed C01-C06 training, C07 checkpoint/threshold selection and one zero-adaptation C08 transfer; no C09/C10/M-TARE, topology graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly approved all in-scope operations, requested continuous autonomous best-choice execution, and requested no routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed deduplicated C01-C08 five-frame causal LiDAR/Teacher dataset.
Sealed axis-anchored Teacher feasibility and multi-label V2 readiness.
Sealed association pair manifest containing cross-traversal positives and same-event geometric hard negatives.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated procedural worlds, objective TNG/spline/mesh teachers and LiDAR derivatives.

worlds.provenance_population: The exact 80 named C01-C08 parents above. C01-C06 fit weights and gradients; C07 selects complete checkpoints and thresholds; C08 is read only after all three checkpoints are frozen.

trajectories.scope: 60 named C01-C06 parents, 12,104 directed traversal identities, exactly enumerated by the sealed sequence manifest
10 named C07 parents, 1,958 directed traversal identities, exactly enumerated by the sealed sequence manifest
10 named C08 parents, 2,014 directed traversal identities, exactly enumerated by the sealed sequence manifest

sampling.independent_sampling_units: Procedural parent world and directed traversal identity; descriptor positives are cross-view rows of one objective structural identity, with different nodes and geometrically similar parallel tunnels as negatives.
sampling.rule: Every fit observation contributes once per epoch to core event/relation/geometry training. Within each world, two canonical full-star rows are selected deterministically for every pairable association identity and one row for every singleton identity; these rows form independent descriptor-only batches.

teacher.source: Frozen TNG event/association/exit identity, spline route axis/slope/curvature and native geometry width/clearance fields sealed in the dataset.
teacher.student_input: Only five past-to-current normalized range images and valid-return masks; fixed 50 m division is the only normalization.
teacher.event_target: corridor, junction, terminal, turn or geometry_transition at the current observation.
teacher.relation_target: Three independent persistent/reveal/withdraw binary fields over four adjacent causal pairs and 180 route-axis bins; -1 masks only pairs lacking same-traversal observation Teacher.
teacher.valid_mask: Relation -1 masks are loss-excluded; branch width masks are subsets of visible current branches; four global geometry masks are preserved per row; no invalid target is imputed.
teacher.geometry_target: Current branch residual heading/opening width/vertical profile and global local-axis/width/height/slope/curvature with frozen validity masks.
teacher.identity_target: association_identity and exit_identity are loss/evaluation only and are forbidden model-forward inputs.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No planner or graph is run. A future graph may commit nodes only from accepted stable learned events and may create edges only after physical traversal.

split.fit: C01-C06 only: gradients, AdamW updates, event weights and relation positive rates.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07 only: minimum complete core-plus-descriptor loss checkpoint, then relation/branch/association/refusal thresholds.
split.zero_adaptation_transfer: C08 is inferred exactly once from the three frozen checkpoints; no loss, checkpoint, weight, threshold or hyperparameter is selected from C08.
split.strict_test: C09, C10 and M-TARE remain unread.
split.historical_pollution_audit: No historical GSE checkpoint initializes any seed. The failed categorical V1/V1R relation interface is retained only as ablation evidence.

methods.main: Three from-scratch 819067-parameter axis-anchored five-frame models with multi-label temporal relation fields, event/global/branch geometry heads and identity-balanced place/branch descriptor training.
methods.baseline: Strongest frozen five-event baseline macro-F1=0.6879041032; deterministic RangeGeometryBaseline on identical current scans; categorical V1/V1R relation interface as representation failure; sealed rule/exit-token association evidence.
methods.fallback: If any event, temporal relation, branch field, geometry, association or uncertainty-refusal gate fails, seal all outputs and run one frozen-output attribution before changing the representation. No graph, planner, looser metric, seed picking, C08 calibration or retry.

training.augmentation: One deterministic whole-observation circular roll in multiples of 2 degrees; target relation/branch fields and local axis rotate exactly with the scan.

acceptance.event: Ensemble five-event macro-F1 >=0.7379041032 on both C07 and C08.
acceptance.relations: Each C07-selected persistent/reveal/withdraw threshold has precision >=0.98 and recall >=0.25 on both C07 and C08.
acceptance.branch_field: One C07-selected current-branch threshold has precision >=0.995 and recall >=0.50 on both splits.
acceptance.geometry: Mean four-field relative MAE improvement over the deterministic baseline >=10%, no field regresses >5%, and axis error <=10 degrees on both splits.
acceptance.association: Combined place-plus-branch score has precision >=0.98, false merge <=1% and recall >=0.25 on both splits using one C07 threshold.
acceptance.uncertainty: One C07 structural-event refusal threshold transfers with precision >=0.98, false acceptance <=1% and recall >=0.25.
acceptance.system: Exactly 36,690 optimizer steps, three complete checkpoints, zero C08 checkpoint observations and zero C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.

failure_policy: Do not lower gates, widen bins, remove rare events, delete early rows, select a seed, recalibrate on C08, add epochs, change the optimizer, enter topology or retry after scientific failure.
retention: Retain three checkpoints/histories, compact C07/C08 predictions, exact thresholds and metrics, per-world table, paper-ready figure/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential deterministic RTX 5090 D trainings plus C07 selection, one C08 transfer and CPU non-learning geometry baseline
